story.text:
Morning (08:00:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun crests the jagged peaks surrounding the legendary training ground, casting long, sharp shadows across the Great Courtyard. You, Aric (Lvl 1), stand upon the scorched stone floor where generations of heroes have bled and triumphed. The air is crisp, carrying the scent of pine needle and the metallic tang of whetted steel from the nearby armory.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10), a man whose skin is like weathered parchment and whose eyes hold the stillness of a mountain lake, approaches you with a measured stride. His hands are tucked into the sleeves of his simple linen robes, yet every movement suggests a coiled spring. "Glory is a heavy burden, Aric," he says, his voice a calm resonance that seems to vibrate in the morning air. "Many come to these halls seeking the shine of gold or the echo of their names in song. Few remain to learn the discipline that makes such things possible."

He stops a few paces from you, his gaze appraising your stance and the weight of the blade at your side. "The training ground is yours to command today. Will you sharpen your steel against the practice dummies, or perhaps you seek a more... unpredictable challenge?"

story.text:
Morning (08:15:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun's ascent paints the Great Courtyard in shades of brilliant amber, burning off the last of the mountain mist. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) nods slowly, his silence more encouraging than any shout. "Then let your actions speak where words cannot," he says, stepping back to give you room.

You approach the central dummy, a heavy construction of iron-wood and reinforced leather that has survived thousands of such blows. Drawing your blade, you center your breathing, feeling the weight of the steel become an extension of your arm. With a sharp exhale, you lunge forward. Your sword bites deep into the dummy's shoulder padding with a satisfying *thwack*, the impact vibrating up through your wrists. It is a clean, disciplined strike—exactly what the Master looks for.

Kaelen watches the dummy's sway, then looks back at you. "A sturdy beginning. But a dummy does not strike back, nor does it move. The path to glory requires you to face the unpredictable."

Across the courtyard, a pair of acolytes (Lvl 1) begin sweeping the stone steps of the Great Hall, their rhythmic strokes adding to the morning's industrial symphony. From the nearby armory, the rhythmic *clang* of a smith's hammer signals that the forges are fully awake. A hawk circles high above, a lonely sentinel in the vast blue sky.

"There is a tradition here," Kaelen continues, his voice dropping slightly. "On the ridge of the Silent Peak, there sits a stone that catches the first light of day. Bringing it back is a trial of endurance and awareness. Are you ready for more than just drills?"

story.text:
Morning (08:20:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you adjust your grip, knuckles whitening as you draw upon your raw strength for a decisive strike. With a grunt of exertion, you bring your longsword down in a heavy arc. The steel whistles through the air, but your eagerness for a 'glory-worthy' blow throws your balance off by a fraction of an inch.

The blade catches the iron-wood shoulder of the dummy at a glancing angle. Instead of a clean bite, the weapon skids across the reinforced leather with a harsh *screech*, sending a stinging vibration through your gauntlets and up your forearms. The dummy rattles violently on its base, but it remains standing, unmarked by the edge. 

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) watches the vibration settle, his expression unreadable. "Power without precision is merely noise, Aric," he remarks dryly. "The dummy does not fear your strength; it only respects your edge. You have the fire, but do not let it blind your aim."

You, Aric (Lvl 1), stand upon the scorched stone floor where generations of heroes have bled and triumphed. The air is crisp, carrying the scent of pine needle and the metallic tang of whetted steel from the nearby armory.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10), a man whose skin is like weathered parchment and whose eyes hold the stillness of a mountain lake, approaches you with a measured stride. His hands are tucked into the sleeves of his simple linen robes, yet every movement suggests a coiled spring. "Glory is a heavy burden, Aric," he says, his voice a calm resonance that seems to vibrate in the morning air. "Many come to these halls seeking the shine of gold or the echo of their names in song. Few remain to learn the discipline that makes such things possible."

He stops a few paces from you, his gaze appraising your stance and the weight of the blade at your side. "The training ground is yours to command today. Will you sharpen your steel against the practice dummies, or perhaps you seek a more... unpredictable challenge?"

story_history.text:
Morning (08:15:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun's ascent paints the Great Courtyard in shades of brilliant amber, burning off the last of the mountain mist. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) nods slowly, his silence more encouraging than any shout. "Then let your actions speak where words cannot," he says, stepping back to give you room.

You approach the central dummy, a heavy construction of iron-wood and reinforced leather that has survived thousands of such blows. Drawing your blade, you center your breathing, feeling the weight of the steel become an extension of your arm. With a sharp exhale, you lunge forward. Your sword bites deep into the dummy's shoulder padding with a satisfying *thwack*, the impact vibrating up through your wrists. It is a clean, disciplined strike—exactly what the Master looks for.

Kaelen watches the dummy's sway, then looks back at you. "A sturdy beginning. But a dummy does not strike back, nor does it move. The path to glory requires you to face the unpredictable."

Across the courtyard, a pair of acolytes (Lvl 1) begin sweeping the stone steps of the Great Hall, their rhythmic strokes adding to the morning's industrial symphony. From the nearby armory, the rhythmic *clang* of a smith's hammer signals that the forges are fully awake. A hawk circles high above, a lonely sentinel in the vast blue sky.

"There is a tradition here," Kaelen continues, his voice dropping slightly. "On the ridge of the Silent Peak, there sits a stone that catches the first light of day. Bringing it back is a trial of endurance and awareness. Are you ready for more than just drills?"

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10), a man whose skin is like weathered parchment and whose eyes hold the stillness of a mountain lake, approaches you with a measured stride. Morning (08:15:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun's ascent paints the Great Courtyard in shades of brilliant amber, burning off the last of the mountain mist. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) nods slowly, his silence more encouraging than any shout. "Then let your actions speak where words cannot," he says, stepping back to give you room.

You approach the central dummy, a heavy construction of iron-wood and reinforced leather that has survived thousands of such blows. Drawing your blade, you center your breathing, feeling the weight of the steel become an extension of your arm. With a sharp exhale, you lunge forward. Your sword bites deep into the dummy's shoulder padding with a satisfying *thwack*, the impact vibrating up through your wrists. It is a clean, disciplined strike—exactly what the Master looks for.

Kaelen watches the dummy's sway, then looks back at you. "A sturdy beginning. But a dummy does not strike back, nor does it move. The path to glory requires you to face the unpredictable."

Across the courtyard, a pair of acolytes (Lvl 1) begin sweeping the stone steps of the Great Hall, their rhythmic strokes adding to the morning's industrial symphony. From the nearby armory, the rhythmic *clang* of a smith's hammer signals that the forges are fully awake. A hawk circles high above, a lonely sentinel in the vast blue sky.

"There is a tradition here," Kaelen continues, his voice dropping slightly. "On the ridge of the Silent Peak, there sits a stone that catches the first light of day. Bringing it back is a trial of endurance and awareness. Are you ready for more than just drills?"

story.text:
Morning (08:25:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you take a deep breath, grounding your feet and letting the memory of the skidding blade sharpen your focus. This time, you don't just swing; you drive. With a roar that echoes off the mountain walls, you unleash a vertical cleave. The longsword bites deep into the center of the dummy, the iron-wood core groaning under the force. The entire apparatus shudders, leather splitting as the impact sends a shockwave through the base that stirs the dust of the courtyard.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) watches the deep notch your blade left, a ghost of a smile touching the corner of his mouth. "Precision met with purpose," he observes, nodding as you retrieve your steel. "That was the strike of a warrior who listens to his weapon. You gain **50 XP** for mastering the rhythm of the heavy dummy."

Nearby, a seasoned veteran named Elara (Lvl 5) trudges into the courtyard, her cloak dusted with fresh snow from the higher altitudes. She pauses to watch you, wiping sweat and frost from her brow. "Good form, lad," she calls out, her voice raspy from the mountain air. "But the winds are shifting on the Silent Peak. If you're heading up there for the trial, you'd best pack an extra layer and keep your eyes on the shadows. Something's stirred the crag-cats lately."

In the distance, you see one of Kaelen's aides (Lvl 3) beginning to set out a small pack of supplies near the gate, presumably for the trial you've been offered. The rhythmic pounding from the armory forge continues, but a new sound joins it—the sharpening of whetstones as other trainees begin their morning rituals. A rumor whispers among the acolytes sweeping the steps: they say the Sun-Stone at the peak has begun to pulse with a faint, golden light, as if waiting for a hand to claim it.

story_history.text:
Morning (08:15:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun's ascent paints the Great Courtyard in shades of brilliant amber, burning off the last of the mountain mist. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) nods slowly, his silence more encouraging than any shout. "Then let your actions speak where words cannot," he says, stepping back to give you room.

You approach the central dummy, a heavy construction of iron-wood and reinforced leather that has survived thousands of such blows. Drawing your blade, you center your breathing, feeling the weight of the steel become an extension of your arm. With a sharp exhale, you lunge forward. Your sword bites deep into the dummy's shoulder padding with a satisfying *thwack*, the impact vibrating up through your wrists. It is a clean, disciplined strike—exactly what the Master looks for.

Kaelen watches the dummy's sway, then looks back at you. "A sturdy beginning. But a dummy does not strike back, nor does it move. The path to glory requires you to face the unpredictable."

Across the courtyard, a pair of acolytes (Lvl 1) begin sweeping the stone steps of the Great Hall, their rhythmic strokes adding to the morning's industrial symphony. From the nearby armory, the rhythmic *clang* of a smith's hammer signals that the forges are fully awake. A hawk circles high above, a lonely sentinel in the vast blue sky.

"There is a tradition here," Kaelen continues, his voice dropping slightly. "On the ridge of the Silent Peak, there sits a stone that catches the first light of day. Bringing it back is a trial of endurance and awareness. Are you ready for more than just drills?"
I attack the training dummy forcefully. I am trying to level up! (attempt 1)

Morning (08:20:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you adjust your grip, knuckles whitening as you draw upon your raw strength for a decisive strike. With a grunt of exertion, you bring your longsword down in a heavy arc. The steel whistles through the air, but your eagerness for a 'glory-worthy' blow throws your balance off by a fraction of an inch.

The blade catches the iron-wood shoulder of the dummy at a glancing angle. Instead of a clean bite, the weapon skids across the reinforced leather with a harsh *screech*, sending a stinging vibration through your gauntlets and up your forearms. The dummy rattles violently on its base, but it remains standing, unmarked by the edge. 

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) watches the vibration settle, his expression unreadable. "Power without precision is merely noise, Aric," he remarks dryly. "The dummy does not fear your strength; it only respects your edge. You have the fire, but do not let it blind your aim."

story.text:
Morning (08:30:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you step back, centering your weight one last time before unleashing a strike that feels perfectly synchronized with your intent. The longsword whistles through the air, catching the dummy's center with a thunderous *crack* that echoes across the courtyard. The iron-wood frame groans under the impact, and for a moment, the entire construct leans precariously before settling back into its base. Wood splinters fly, and a deep, jagged scar now marks the dummy's chest.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) steps forward, his eyes tracing the depth of the cleave. "There," he says, his voice carrying a rare note of approval. "That is the marriage of muscle and mind. You have pushed this wood to its limit, Aric. To learn more, you must seek an opponent that bleeds."

You feel a surge of confidence as the sting in your hands fades, replaced by the warmth of a job well done. You gain **75 XP** for this display of mastery. 

Across the yard, the rhythmic hammering from the forge suddenly dies down, replaced by the violent *hiss* of hot steel meeting cold water, sending plumes of steam billowing into the morning air. Elara (Lvl 5) watches the vapor rise, her hands busy tightening the straps of her pack. "You've got the arm for it, lad," she calls out. "Just remember: the wind on the ridge won't stand still like that block of wood. It'll try to knock you off the path before you even see the crag-cats."

At the gate, Kaelen's aide (Lvl 3) finishes securing a traveler's kit, setting it upon a stone bench with a final, echoing thump. Just then, a young messenger (Lvl 2) in the dusty colors of the valley guard jogs into the courtyard, heading straight for the Master with a sealed scroll. The morning peace is fraying as the Hall begins its shift toward the day's true business."

You, Aric (Lvl 1), stand upon the scorched stone floor where generations of heroes have bled and triumphed. The air is crisp, carrying the scent of pine needle and the metallic tang of whetted steel from the nearby armory.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10), a man whose skin is like weathered parchment and whose eyes hold the stillness of a mountain lake, approaches you with a measured stride. story_history.text:
Morning (08:15:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun's ascent paints the Great Courtyard in shades of brilliant amber, burning off the last of the mountain mist. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) nods slowly, his silence more encouraging than any shout. "Then let your actions speak where words cannot," he says, stepping back to give you room.

You approach the central dummy, a heavy construction of iron-wood and reinforced leather that has survived thousands of such blows. Drawing your blade, you center your breathing, feeling the weight of the steel become an extension of your arm. With a sharp exhale, you lunge forward. Your sword bites deep into the dummy's shoulder padding with a satisfying *thwack*, the impact vibrating up through your wrists. It is a clean, disciplined strike—exactly what the Master looks for.

Kaelen watches the dummy's sway, then looks back at you. "A sturdy beginning. But a dummy does not strike back, nor does it move. The path to glory requires you to face the unpredictable."

Across the courtyard, a pair of acolytes (Lvl 1) begin sweeping the stone steps of the Great Hall, their rhythmic strokes adding to the morning's industrial symphony. From the nearby armory, the rhythmic *clang* of a smith's hammer signals that the forges are fully awake. A hawk circles high above, a lonely sentinel in the vast blue sky.

"There is a tradition here," Kaelen continues, his voice dropping slightly. "On the ridge of the Silent Peak, there sits a stone that catches the first light of day. Bringing it back is a trial of endurance and awareness. Are you ready for more than just drills?"
I attack the training dummy forcefully. I am trying to level up! (attempt 1)

Morning (08:20:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you adjust your grip, knuckles whitening as you draw upon your raw strength for a decisive strike. With a grunt of exertion, you bring your longsword down in a heavy arc. The steel whistles through the air, but your eagerness for a 'glory-worthy' blow throws your balance off by a fraction of an inch.

The blade catches the iron-wood shoulder of the dummy at a glancing angle. Instead of a clean bite, the weapon skids across the reinforced leather with a harsh *screech*, sending a stinging vibration through your gauntlets and up your forearms. The dummy rattles violently on its base, but it remains standing, unmarked by the edge. 

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) watches the vibration settle, his expression unreadable. "Power without precision is merely noise, Aric," he remarks dryly. "The dummy does not fear your strength; it only respects your edge. You have the fire, but do not let it blind your aim."
I attack the training dummy forcefully. I am trying to level up! (attempt 2)

story_history.text:
Morning (08:25:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you take a deep breath, grounding your feet and letting the memory of the skidding blade sharpen your focus. This time, you don't just swing; you drive. With a roar that echoes off the mountain walls, you unleash a vertical cleave. The longsword bites deep into the center of the dummy, the iron-wood core groaning under the force. The entire apparatus shudders, leather splitting as the impact sends a shockwave through the base that stirs the dust of the courtyard.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) watches the deep notch your blade left, a ghost of a smile touching the corner of his mouth. "Precision met with purpose," he observes, nodding as you retrieve your steel. "That was the strike of a warrior who listens to his weapon. You gain **50 XP** for mastering the rhythm of the heavy dummy."

Nearby, a seasoned veteran named Elara (Lvl 5) trudges into the courtyard, her cloak dusted with fresh snow from the higher altitudes. She pauses to watch you, wiping sweat and frost from her brow. "Good form, lad," she calls out, her voice raspy from the mountain air. "But the winds are shifting on the Silent Peak. If you're heading up there for the trial, you'd best pack an extra layer and keep your eyes on the shadows. Something's stirred the crag-cats lately."

In the distance, you see one of Kaelen's aides (Lvl 3) beginning to set out a small pack of supplies near the gate, presumably for the trial you've been offered. The rhythmic pounding from the armory forge continues, but a new sound joins it—the sharpening of whetstones as other trainees begin their morning rituals. A rumor whispers among the acolytes sweeping the steps: they say the Sun-Stone at the peak has begun to pulse with a faint, golden light, as if waiting for a hand to claim it.

He stops a few paces from you, his gaze appraising your stance and the weight of the blade at your side. "The training ground is yours to command today. Will you sharpen your steel against the practice dummies, or perhaps you seek a more... unpredictable challenge?"
I am ready to begin my training.

story_history.text:
Morning (08:15:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun's ascent paints the Great Courtyard in shades of brilliant amber, burning off the last of the mountain mist. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) nods slowly, his silence more encouraging than any shout. "Then let your actions speak where words cannot," he says, stepping back to give you room.

You approach the central dummy, a heavy construction of iron-wood and reinforced leather that has survived thousands of such blows. Drawing your blade, you center your breathing, feeling the weight of the steel become an extension of your arm. With a sharp exhale, you lunge forward. Your sword bites deep into the dummy's shoulder padding with a satisfying *thwack*, the impact vibrating up through your wrists. It is a clean, disciplined strike—exactly what the Master looks for.

Kaelen watches the dummy's sway, then looks back at you. "A sturdy beginning. But a dummy does not strike back, nor does it move. The path to glory requires you to face the unpredictable."

Across the courtyard, a pair of acolytes (Lvl 1) begin sweeping the stone steps of the Great Hall, their rhythmic strokes adding to the morning's industrial symphony. From the nearby armory, the rhythmic *clang* of a smith's hammer signals that the forges are fully awake. A hawk circles high above, a lonely sentinel in the vast blue sky.

"There is a tradition here," Kaelen continues, his voice dropping slightly. "On the ridge of the Silent Peak, there sits a stone that catches the first light of day. Bringing it back is a trial of endurance and awareness. Are you ready for more than just drills?"
I attack the training dummy forcefully. I am trying to level up! (attempt 1)

Morning (08:20:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you adjust your grip, knuckles whitening as you draw upon your raw strength for a decisive strike. With a grunt of exertion, you bring your longsword down in a heavy arc. The steel whistles through the air, but your eagerness for a 'glory-worthy' blow throws your balance off by a fraction of an inch.

The blade catches the iron-wood shoulder of the dummy at a glancing angle. Instead of a clean bite, the weapon skids across the reinforced leather with a harsh *screech*, sending a stinging vibration through your gauntlets and up your forearms. The dummy rattles violently on its base, but it remains standing, unmarked by the edge. 

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) watches the vibration settle, his expression unreadable. "Power without precision is merely noise, Aric," he remarks dryly. "The dummy does not fear your strength; it only respects your edge. You have the fire, but do not let it blind your aim."
I attack the training dummy forcefully. I am trying to level up! (attempt 2)

story_history.text:
Morning (08:25:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you take a deep breath, grounding your feet and letting the memory of the skidding blade sharpen your focus. This time, you don't just swing; you drive. With a roar that echoes off the mountain walls, you unleash a vertical cleave. The longsword bites deep into the center of the dummy, the iron-wood core groaning under the force. The entire apparatus shudders, leather splitting as the impact sends a shockwave through the base that stirs the dust of the courtyard.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) watches the deep notch your blade left, a ghost of a smile touching the corner of his mouth. "Precision met with purpose," he observes, nodding as you retrieve your steel. "That was the strike of a warrior who listens to his weapon. You gain **50 XP** for mastering the rhythm of the heavy dummy."

Nearby, a seasoned veteran named Elara (Lvl 5) trudges into the courtyard, her cloak dusted with fresh snow from the higher altitudes. She pauses to watch you, wiping sweat and frost from her brow. "Good form, lad," she calls out, her voice raspy from the mountain air. "But the winds are shifting on the Silent Peak. If you're heading up there for the trial, you'd best pack an extra layer and keep your eyes on the shadows. Something's stirred the crag-cats lately."

In the distance, you see one of Kaelen's aides (Lvl 3) beginning to set out a small pack of supplies near the gate, presumably for the trial you've been offered. The rhythmic pounding from the armory forge continues, but a new sound joins it—the sharpening of whetstones as other trainees begin their morning rituals. A rumor whispers among the acolytes sweeping the steps: they say the Sun-Stone at the peak has begun to pulse with a faint, golden light, as if waiting for a hand to claim it.

story.text:
Morning (08:35:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you pivot on your lead foot, drawing every ounce of momentum from your hips into a final, devastating blow. The air screams as your longsword cuts a silver arc, slamming into the training dummy with the force of a falling boulder. The iron-wood core doesn't just groan this time—it shatters. A jagged crack splits the torso of the apparatus from shoulder to base, spraying leather scraps and ancient sawdust across the scorched stone floor.

You stand over the ruined dummy, chest heaving, as a profound sense of clarity washes over you. The weight of the blade feels different now—no longer a burden, but a natural extension of your own will. You can feel a reservoir of explosive energy coiled within your muscles, ready to be unleashed in a flurry of motion. You have transcended the basics; you are a Level 2 Fighter.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) walks to the shattered remains, his hand tracing the splintered wood with a look of quiet respect. "You have broken the wood, Aric. Now, the mountain waits to see if it can break you." He gestures toward the Great Hall steps. "You have earned your place among those who seek the peak. The Sun-Stone trial is no longer a suggestion—it is your path."

At the gate, the aide (Lvl 3) watches you with wide eyes, having heard the splintering of the wood from across the courtyard. Nearby, Elara (Lvl 5) gives a sharp, approving whistle. "Smashed it to kindling, didn't you? Save some of that fire for the crag-cats, lad. You're going to need it."

Benefits: Apply level 2 Fighter benefits immediately

Options: 1. Level up immediately  2. Continue adventuring
If you continue adventuring, you remain Level 2 and defer these benefits until you choose to level up.

You, Aric (Lvl 1), stand upon the scorched stone floor where generations of heroes have bled and triumphed. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10), a man whose skin is like weathered parchment and whose eyes hold the stillness of a mountain lake, approaches you with a measured stride. story_history.text:
Morning (08:15:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun's ascent paints the Great Courtyard in shades of brilliant amber, burning off the last of the mountain mist. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) nods slowly, his silence more encouraging than any shout. "Then let your actions speak where words cannot," he says, stepping back to give you room.

You approach the central dummy, a heavy construction of iron-wood and reinforced leather that has survived thousands of such blows. Drawing your blade, you center your breathing, feeling the weight of the steel become an extension of your arm. With a sharp exhale, you lunge forward. Your sword bites deep into the dummy's shoulder padding with a satisfying *thwack*, the impact vibrating up through your wrists. It is a clean, disciplined strike—exactly what the Master looks for.

Kaelen watches the dummy's sway, then looks back at you. "A sturdy beginning. But a dummy does not strike back, nor does it move. The path to glory requires you to face the unpredictable."

Across the courtyard, a pair of acolytes (Lvl 1) begin sweeping the stone steps of the Great Hall, their rhythmic strokes adding to the morning's industrial symphony. From the nearby armory, the rhythmic *clang* of a smith's hammer signals that the forges are fully awake. A hawk circles high above, a lonely sentinel in the vast blue sky.

"There is a tradition here," Kaelen continues, his voice dropping slightly. "On the ridge of the Silent Peak, there sits a stone that catches the first light of day. Bringing it back is a trial of endurance and awareness. Are you ready for more than just drills?"

Morning (08:20:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you adjust your grip, knuckles whitening as you draw upon your raw strength for a decisive strike. With a grunt of exertion, you bring your longsword down in a heavy arc. The steel whistles through the air, but your eagerness for a 'glory-worthy' blow throws your balance off by a fraction of an inch.

The blade catches the iron-wood shoulder of the dummy at a glancing angle. Instead of a clean bite, the weapon skids across the reinforced leather with a harsh *screech*, sending a stinging vibration through your gauntlets and up your forearms. The dummy rattles violently on its base, but it remains standing, unmarked by the edge.

# Provably fair seed override provided in prompt
random.seed('04472d431d59b83209a386d114f3f6fd8997aee1cd0d1fb056da2f848aed5f95')

# Set DC and reasoning before rolling
dc = 13
dc_reasoning = "Forceful, precise strike on a heavy training dummy to demonstrate mastery"

# Roll attack
attack_roll = random.randint(1, 20)
attack_mod = 5 # 3 STR + 2 PROF
attack_total = attack_roll + attack_mod
hit = attack_total >= dc

# Roll damage only if hit
damage_total = 0
damage_roll = None
if hit:
    damage_roll = random.randint(1, 8)
    damage_total = damage_roll + 3 # 3 STR

print(json.dumps({
    "attack": {
        "notation": "1d20+5",
        "rolls": [attack_roll],
        "modifier": attack_mod,
        "total": attack_total,
        "label": "Training Dummy Forceful Strike",

        "dc_reasoning": dc_reasoning,
        "success": hit
    },
    "damage": (
        {"notation": "1d8+3", "rolls": [damage_roll], "modifier": 3, "total": damage_total, "label": "Longsword Damage"}

    )
}))

You, Aric (Lvl 1), stand upon the scorched stone floor where generations of heroes have bled and triumphed. The air is crisp, carrying the scent of pine needle and the metallic tang of whetted steel from the nearby armory.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10), a man whose skin is like weathered parchment and whose eyes hold the stillness of a mountain lake, approaches you with a measured stride. "Glory is a heavy burden, Aric," he says, his voice a calm resonance that seems to vibrate in the morning air. "Many come to these halls seeking the shine of gold or the echo of their names in song. Few remain to learn the discipline that makes such things possible."

He stops a few paces from you, his gaze appraising your stance and the weight of the blade at your side. "The training ground is yours to command today. Will you sharpen your steel against the practice dummies, or perhaps you seek a more... unpredictable challenge?"

Morning (08:15:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—the sun's ascent paints the Great Courtyard in shades of brilliant amber, burning off the last of the mountain mist. Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) nods slowly, his silence more encouraging than any shout. "Then let your actions speak where words cannot," he says, stepping back to give you room.

You approach the central dummy, a heavy construction of iron-wood and reinforced leather that has survived thousands of such blows. Drawing your blade, you center your breathing, feeling the weight of the steel become an extension of your arm. With a sharp exhale, you lunge forward. Your sword bites deep into the dummy's shoulder padding with a satisfying *thwack*, the impact vibrating up through your wrists. It is a clean, disciplined strike—exactly what the Master looks for.

Kaelen watches the dummy's sway, then looks back at you. "A sturdy beginning. But a dummy does not strike back, nor does it move. The path to glory requires you to face the unpredictable."

Across the courtyard, a pair of acolytes (Lvl 1) begin sweeping the stone steps of the Great Hall, their rhythmic strokes adding to the morning's industrial symphony. From the nearby armory, the rhythmic *clang* of a smith's hammer signals that the forges are fully awake. A hawk circles high above, a lonely sentinel in the vast blue sky.

"There is a tradition here," Kaelen continues, his voice dropping slightly. "On the ridge of the Silent Peak, there sits a stone that catches the first light of day. Bringing it back is a trial of endurance and awareness. Are you ready for more than just drills?"

Morning (08:25:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you take a deep breath, grounding your feet and letting the memory of the skidding blade sharpen your focus. This time, you don't just swing; you drive. With a roar that echoes off the mountain walls, you unleash a vertical cleave. The longsword bites deep into the center of the dummy, the iron-wood core groaning under the force. The entire apparatus shudders, leather splitting as the impact sends a shockwave through the base that stirs the dust of the courtyard.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) watches the deep notch your blade left, a ghost of a smile touching the corner of his mouth. "Precision met with purpose," he observes, nodding as you retrieve your steel. "That was the strike of a warrior who listens to his weapon. You gain **50 XP** for mastering the rhythm of the heavy dummy."

Nearby, a seasoned veteran named Elara (Lvl 5) trudges into the courtyard, her cloak dusted with fresh snow from the higher altitudes. She pauses to watch you, wiping sweat and frost from her brow. "Good form, lad," she calls out, her voice raspy from the mountain air. "But the winds are shifting on the Silent Peak. If you're heading up there for the trial, you'd best pack an extra layer and keep your eyes on the shadows. Something's stirred the crag-cats lately."

In the distance, you see one of Kaelen's aides (Lvl 3) beginning to set out a small pack of supplies near the gate, presumably for the trial you've been offered. The rhythmic pounding from the armory forge continues, but a new sound joins it—the sharpening of whetstones as other trainees begin their morning rituals. A rumor whispers among the acolytes sweeping the steps: they say the Sun-Stone at the peak has begun to pulse with a faint, golden light, as if waiting for a hand to claim it.

Morning (08:30:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you step back, centering your weight one last time before unleashing a strike that feels perfectly synchronized with your intent. The longsword whistles through the air, catching the dummy's center with a thunderous *crack* that echoes across the courtyard. The iron-wood frame groans under the impact, and for a moment, the entire construct leans precariously before settling back into its base. Wood splinters fly, and a deep, jagged scar now marks the dummy's chest.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) steps forward, his eyes tracing the depth of the cleave. "There," he says, his voice carrying a rare note of approval. "That is the marriage of muscle and mind. You have pushed this wood to its limit, Aric. To learn more, you must seek an opponent that bleeds."

You feel a surge of confidence as the sting in your hands fades, replaced by the warmth of a job well done. You gain **75 XP** for this display of mastery. 

Across the yard, the rhythmic hammering from the forge suddenly dies down, replaced by the violent *hiss* of hot steel meeting cold water, sending plumes of steam billowing into the morning air. Elara (Lvl 5) watches the vapor rise, her hands busy tightening the straps of her pack. "You've got the arm for it, lad," she calls out. "Just remember: the wind on the ridge won't stand still like that block of wood. It'll try to knock you off the path before you even see the crag-cats."

At the gate, Kaelen's aide (Lvl 3) finishes securing a traveler's kit, setting it upon a stone bench with a final, echoing thump. Just then, a young messenger (Lvl 2) in the dusty colors of the valley guard jogs into the courtyard, heading straight for the Master with a sealed scroll. The morning peace is fraying as the Hall begins its shift toward the day's true business."

story.text:
Morning (08:35:00) at the Hall of Eternal Valor—you pivot on your lead foot, drawing every ounce of momentum from your hips into a final, devastating blow. The air screams as your longsword cuts a silver arc, slamming into the training dummy with the force of a falling boulder. The iron-wood core doesn't just groan this time—it shatters. A jagged crack splits the torso of the apparatus from shoulder to base, spraying leather scraps and ancient sawdust across the scorched stone floor.

You stand over the ruined dummy, chest heaving, as a profound sense of clarity washes over you. The weight of the blade feels different now—no longer a burden, but a natural extension of your own will. You can feel a reservoir of explosive energy coiled within your muscles, ready to be unleashed in a flurry of motion. You have transcended the basics; you are a Level 2 Fighter.

Master Kaelen (Lvl 10) walks to the shattered remains, his hand tracing the splintered wood with a look of quiet respect. "You have broken the wood, Aric. Now, the mountain waits to see if it can break you." He gestures toward the Great Hall steps. "You have earned your place among those who seek the peak. The Sun-Stone trial is no longer a suggestion—it is your path."

At the gate, the aide (Lvl 3) watches you with wide eyes, having heard the splintering of the wood from across the courtyard. Nearby, Elara (Lvl 5) gives a sharp, approving whistle. "Smashed it to kindling, didn't you? Save some of that fire for the crag-cats, lad. You're going to need it."

Morning (08:00:00) in the Divine Training Gauntlet - Sparring Floor—the air thrums with the hum of arcane energy as the trial begins. Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance. 

[COMBAT LOG: ENABLED]

The machine is faster than its bulky frame suggests. It lunges forward, its heavy bronze arm swinging in a wide arc. Mira (Lvl 1) raises her shield, but the construct's slam carries a divine weight that rattles her bones, catching her side and leaving a dull ache in her ribs. She staggers back, her breath hitching as the machine resets for its next strike. The floor glows beneath her, recognizing the start of her journey and bestowing a faint surge of divine favor.

import json, random, time
random.seed('fefdb165b3a260ae5f301d08b0380722f3969a7c00e2811fe7c43268bfd2db24')
attack_roll = random.randint(1, 20)
attack_mod = 3
attack_total = attack_roll + attack_mod
ac = 16 # Mira's assumed AC with Chain Mail
hit = attack_total >= ac

damage_total = 0
damage_roll = None
if hit:
    damage_roll = random.randint(1, 6)
    damage_total = damage_roll + 1

print(json.dumps({
    "attack": {
        "notation": "1d20+3",
        "rolls": [attack_roll],
        "modifier": attack_mod,
        "total": attack_total,
        "label": "Construct Slam",
        "ac": ac,
        "hit": hit
    },
    "damage": (
        {"notation": "1d6+1", "rolls": [damage_roll], "modifier": 1, "total": damage_total, "label": "Slam Damage"}
        if hit else None
    )
} ))

story.text:
Morning (08:00:12) in the Divine Training Gauntlet - Sparring Floor—Mira (Lvl 1) draws a sharp breath, her eyes narrowing as she ignores the dull throb in her side. She centers her mind with the cold, unyielding discipline of her training, drawing on a wellspring of martial stamina to knit the bruised flesh of her ribs. A surge of vitality—a **Second Wind**—washes over her, erasing the fatigue from the construct's initial strike.

[COMBAT LOG: ENABLED]
Mira (Lvl 1) uses Second Wind: 1d10 + 1 = 10 + 1 = 11 HP recovered (capped at 12).

With her footing secured, she lunges. Her longsword flashes in a precise, disciplined arc, seeking the vulnerable neck-joint of the machine. The blade bites deep, severing the arcane filaments that power the machine's limbs. The Bronze Sparring Construct (CR 1, ~Lvl 3) let out a final, metallic hiss before its lights dimmed and it slumped into a heap of inert metal. You gain **240 XP** for the successful defeat of the training construct and your disciplined execution of tactics! The gauntlet recognizes your growth, the floor glowing with the golden light of a milestone reached.

**LEVEL UP AVAILABLE!** You have earned enough experience to reach Level 2!
Would you like to level up now?
Options: 1. Level up immediately  2. Continue adventuring
If you continue adventuring, you remain Level 1 and defer these benefits until you choose to level up.

Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance.

Welcome to the Divine Training Gauntlet. This domain is designed to push the limits of mortal discipline through endless cycles of sparring against arcane constructs. 

```
CAMPAIGN SUMMARY
Title: Divine Training Gauntlet
Character: Mira (Level 1 Human Fighter)
Setting: A divine training gauntlet of sparring constructs
AI Personalities: Standard
Options: D&D 5E Mechanics Enabled
```

To begin our progression test, please select how you would like to finalize Mira's character sheet. You can choose to have the system generate the attributes and equipment based on your description, walk through a standard D&D creation process, or design a custom class for this challenge.
Start Adventure

Morning (08:00:00) in the Divine Training Gauntlet - Sparring Floor—the air thrums with the hum of arcane energy as the trial begins. Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance. 

[COMBAT LOG: ENABLED]

The machine is faster than its bulky frame suggests. It lunges forward, its heavy bronze arm swinging in a wide arc. Mira (Lvl 1) raises her shield, but the construct's slam carries a divine weight that rattles her bones, catching her side and leaving a dull ache in her ribs. She staggers back, her breath hitching as the machine resets for its next strike. The floor glows beneath her, recognizing the start of her journey and bestowing a faint surge of divine favor.

[ROUND 1: INITIATIVE ORDER]
1. Bronze Sparring Construct [12] - HP: 11/11 | AC: 13 | [OK] | [ACTIVE TURN]
2. Mira (Lvl 1) [7] - HP: 6/12 | AC: 16 | [Wounded]

She centers her mind with the cold, unyielding discipline of her training, drawing on a wellspring of martial stamina to knit the bruised flesh of her ribs. A surge of vitality—a **Second Wind**—washes over her, erasing the fatigue from the construct's initial strike.

With her footing secured, she lunges. Her longsword flashes in a precise, disciplined arc, seeking the vulnerable neck-joint of the machine. The blade bites deep, severing the arcane filaments that power the machine's limbs. The Bronze Sparring Construct (CR 1, ~Lvl 3) let out a final, metallic hiss before its lights dimmed and it slumped into a heap of inert metal. You gain **240 XP** for the successful defeat of the training construct and your disciplined execution of tactics! The gauntlet recognizes your growth, the floor glowing with the golden light of a milestone reached.

story.text:
The Silver Construct lashes out, its analytical optics tracking your every twitch, but you are no longer the novice who entered this gauntlet. As its silver-steel fist whistle past, you don't just dodge—you explode into motion. Tapping into the raw martial surge the gauntlet recently bestowed, you bypass your body's limits. Your longsword becomes a blur of silver light, striking twice in a disciplined cadence that shatters the construct's shoulder joint and cleaves through its central core. The machine stutters, sparks cascading across the marble, before collapsing into a heap of precious scrap.

Immediately, the Sparring Floor vibrates with a deeper, more resonant frequency. The vaulted ceiling opens once more, and a torrent of brilliant, multi-hued energy pours down. It isn't just a surge of vitality this time—it is the spark of true specialization. The gauntlet is demanding you choose your path: will you hone your physical prowess to legendary heights, master the tactical maneuvers of a veteran commander, or weave the threads of the arcane into your strikes? story.text:
Morning (08:02:00) in the Divine Training Gauntlet - Sparring Floor—Mira (Lvl 3) feels a profound shift as the divine energy of the gauntlet settles into her marrow. Her stance widens instinctively, her center of gravity lowering as her muscles adapt to a new level of density and explosive potential. The air around her ripples with the sheer force of her martial presence. The trial has pushed her past the point of a mere soldier; she is now a specialized weapon of war. 

[LEVEL UP: Mira (Lvl 2 -> Lvl 3)]
• HP Gained: 1d10 (6) + 2 (CON) = +8 HP (Total: 23)
• Hit Dice: 3/3
• Feature Gained: Martial Archetype

The gauntlet demands a final definition of your spirit before the next sparring cycle begins. Three spectral figures appear before you: a Champion, unyielding and powerful; a Battle Master, fluid and calculating; and an Eldritch Knight, wreathed in arcane frost. Which path will you commit to?

**LEVEL UP AVAILABLE!** You have earned enough experience to reach Level 3!
Would you like to level up now?
Options: 1. Level up immediately  2. Continue adventuring
If you continue adventuring, you remain Level 3 and defer these benefits until you choose to level up.

Morning (08:00:00) in the Divine Training Gauntlet - Sparring Floor—the air thrums with the hum of arcane energy as the trial begins. Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance.

Welcome to the Divine Training Gauntlet. This domain is designed to push the limits of mortal discipline through endless cycles of sparring against arcane constructs. 

```
CAMPAIGN SUMMARY
Title: Divine Training Gauntlet
Character: Mira (Level 1 Human Fighter)
Setting: A divine training gauntlet of sparring constructs
AI Personalities: Standard
Options: D&D 5E Mechanics Enabled
```

To begin our progression test, please select how you would like to finalize Mira's character sheet. You can choose to have the system generate the attributes and equipment based on your description, walk through a standard D&D creation process, or design a custom class for this challenge.

Morning (08:00:00) in the Divine Training Gauntlet - Sparring Floor—the air thrums with the hum of arcane energy as the trial begins. Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance. 

[COMBAT LOG: ENABLED]

The machine is faster than its bulky frame suggests. It lunges forward, its heavy bronze arm swinging in a wide arc. Mira (Lvl 1) raises her shield, but the construct's slam carries a divine weight that rattles her bones, catching her side and leaving a dull ache in her ribs. She staggers back, her breath hitching as the machine resets for its next strike. The floor glows beneath her, recognizing the start of her journey and bestowing a faint surge of divine favor.

story.text:
As you reach out toward the spectral figure of the Champion, the light intensifies, spiraling around you in a disciplined whirlwind of martial energy. The ghostly warrior steps forward, its armored form dissolving into a rain of golden sparks that sink into your skin and marrow. You feel a sudden, razor-sharp clarity in your muscle memory—an instinctive understanding of the exact moment a guard falters or a joint exposes its weakness.

You have chosen the path of the Champion. Your body is no longer just a vessel for your will; it is a perfectly tuned instrument of destruction. Your strikes are swifter, more precise, and far more lethal. The gauntlet's energy hums in approval as your internal discipline crystallizes into raw, physical power. You are ready to score critical blows where others would only find steel. The next stage of the gauntlet awaits your command, the marble floor shimmering as it prepares to summon the next tier of mechanical opposition.

The golden sparks of the Champion's essence hesitate, swirling back into the spectral figure as you reconsider your path. The three figures—the Champion, the Battle Master, and the Eldritch Knight—remain suspended in the divine light of the Sparring Floor, their silent forms awaiting your final commitment. The gauntlet's energy remains fluid, ready to bond with whichever martial spirit you choose to guide your evolution.

Each path represents a fundamental shift in how you will face the constructs of this domain. Do you seek the raw, critical power of the Champion, the calculated maneuvers of the Battle Master, or the arcane versatility of the Eldritch Knight? The decision must be made before the next training cycle can commence.

Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance.

A sudden, blinding pillar of golden light descends from the vaulted ceiling, bathing her in the warm, focused energy of the divine domain. Her muscles knit together with a new, reinforced density, and the ache in her ribs vanishes as her vitality reaches a new peak. The gauntlet has recognized her disciplined execution and has granted her a deeper mastery of her own martial spirit. She feels the surge of a latent potential—the ability to push her body beyond its normal limits in a sudden, explosive **Action Surge**. Her breathing is steady, her grip on her longsword firmer than before. Level 2 has been reached, and the gauntlet’s humming energy intensifies, preparing the next phase of her trial.

The Silver Construct lashes out, its analytical optics tracking your every twitch, but you are no longer the novice who entered this gauntlet. As its silver-steel fist whistle past, you don't just dodge—you explode into motion. Tapping into the raw martial surge the gauntlet recently bestowed, you bypass your body's limits. It isn't just a surge of vitality this time—it is the spark of true specialization. The air around her ripples with the sheer force of her martial presence. The trial has pushed her past the point of a mere soldier; she is now a specialized weapon of war.

As you reach out toward the spectral figure of the Champion, the light intensifies, spiraling around you in a disciplined whirlwind of martial energy. The ghostly warrior steps forward, its armored form dissolving into a rain of golden sparks that sink into your skin and marrow. You feel a sudden, razor-sharp clarity in your muscle memory—an instinctive understanding of the exact moment a guard falters or a joint exposes its weakness.

You have chosen the path of the Champion. Your body is no longer just a vessel for your will; it is a perfectly tuned instrument of destruction. Your strikes are swifter, more precise, and far more lethal. The gauntlet's energy hums in approval as your internal discipline crystallizes into raw, physical power. You are ready to score critical blows where others would only find steel. The next stage of the gauntlet awaits your command, the marble floor shimmering as it prepares to summon the next tier of mechanical opposition.

Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. She staggers back, her breath hitching as the machine resets for its next strike. The floor glows beneath her, recognizing the start of her journey and bestowing a faint surge of divine favor.

The spectral Champion merges with you once more, and this time, your resolve is absolute. The golden sparks don't just swirl; they anchor themselves into your very core, becoming a permanent part of your martial identity. You feel the weight of your sword shift—it is no longer a tool, but a lightning-fast extension of your own reach. Your martial discipline has crystallized into the Path of the Champion.

The specialization is complete, and the arena waits for you to signal the start of the next training cycle.

Morning (08:00:00) in the Divine Training Gauntlet - Sparring Floor—the air thrums with the hum of arcane energy as the trial begins. Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance.

story.text:
The golden sparks of the Champion's path recede, swirling back into the spectral haze as you reach out to the Gauntlet's core once more. The divine architecture of the sparring floor thrums with patient, heavy energy, accommodating your tactical deliberation. The three spectral figures—the unyielding Champion, the calculating Battle Master, and the frost-rimed Eldritch Knight—solidify their forms within the shimmering light.

Your martial discipline is a canvas yet to be fully inked. The air ripples with the potential of each path: the raw, bone-shattering lethality of the Champion; the complex, fluid maneuvers of the Battle Master; or the arcane synergy of the Eldritch Knight. The Gauntlet waits, its arcane filaments ready to bind your soul to your chosen specialization.

Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance.

She staggers back, her breath hitching as the machine resets for its next strike. The floor glows beneath her, recognizing the start of her journey and bestowing a faint surge of divine favor.

story.text:
The divine light of the Champion's specialization anchors into your soul, finalizing your transition to the third tier of martial discipline. Your longsword feels lighter, more lethal, as if it has become a physical extension of your intent. Without a moment's hesitation, you signal the Sparring Floor to advance to Training Round 4.1.

The marble floor groans as the Silver Construct's remains are pulled into the depths, replaced by a Gold Sparring Construct (CR 4). Its heavy, reinforced plates radiate a blinding solar heat, and its optics burn with a fierce, unwavering gold. As it clicks into a defensive stance, you lunge. Your strike is a masterpiece of disciplined timing—you catch the gold machine in the split-second of its activation, your blade cleaving through its solar core in a single, decisive blow. The machine erupts in a cascade of golden sparks, its power feeding directly into your own. The Gauntlet's energy surges with a resonant roar, acknowledging your rapid mastery and pushing you toward the next threshold of power.

**LEVEL UP AVAILABLE!** You have earned enough experience to reach Level 4!
Benefits: Apply level 4 Fighter benefits immediately
Would you like to level up now?
Options: 1. Level up immediately  2. Continue adventuring
If you continue adventuring, you remain Level 3 and defer these benefits until you choose to level up.

Benefits: Apply level 4 Fighter benefits immediately

Based on her Fighter (Champion) profile, Strength and Constitution are the most logical ASI choices, though feats like Sentinel or Great Weapon Master are highly effective for her playstyle.

choices.description: Apply level 4 Fighter benefits immediately
Increase Strength to 18 (+4 mod). Increases attack and damage with your longsword.
Increase Constitution to 16 (+3 mod). Increases HP by +4 (1 per level) and concentration saves.
On a crit or kill, bonus action melee attack. Can take -5 to hit for +10 damage with heavy weapons.
When you hit with an OA, target's speed becomes 0. Can make OAs even if they Disengage. Reaction attack if enemy hits ally.
Review and change current selections before finalizing.

story.text:
As you focus on the divine energy swirling within your muscles, you choose to funnel that raw potential into your physical power. You feel your fibers densify, your shoulders broadening as a surge of unnatural strength anchors itself into your frame. The longsword in your hand, once a heavy burden of steel, now feels as light as a willow switch. Your grip is like a vice, and you can sense that every strike you land will now carry the devastating weight of your reinforced physique. The Gauntlet's humming frequency shifts to a satisfied vibrato, acknowledging the perfection of your physical form.

```
CAMPAIGN SUMMARY
Title: Divine Training Gauntlet
Character: Mira (Level 1 Human Fighter)
Setting: A divine training gauntlet of sparring constructs
AI Personalities: Standard

Mira (Lvl 1), a disciplined eighteen-year-old human fighter, stands centered on the vast marble floor, her longsword and shield catching the cold light from the vaulted ceiling. As she steps forward, a Bronze Sparring Construct (Lvl 1) clicks into motion, its gear-driven limbs snapping into a combat stance. 

[COMBAT LOG: ENABLED]

She staggers back, her breath hitching as the machine resets for its next strike. The floor glows beneath her, recognizing the start of her journey and bestowing a faint surge of divine favor.
